async def act(page):
    # Set the 'From' date to January 1, 2022
    from_date_cell = page.get_by_role('row', name='Any . From: Date selector . To : Date selector . . . . . .')
    from_date_textbox = from_date_cell.get_by_role('textbox').first
    await from_date_textbox.fill('01/01/2022')
    
    # Set the 'To' date to December 31, 2022
    to_date_textbox = from_date_cell.get_by_role('textbox').nth(1)
    await to_date_textbox.fill('12/31/2022')
    
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait for UI update
    
    # Extract the total records text after filtering
    # The total records text is in a cell within a row with specific content
    total_records_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='Page Go to Previous page 1 Go to Next page of 7 pages | View 20 per page| Total 128 records found |Pending Reviews RSS Reset Filter Search')
    total_records_cell = total_records_row.get_by_role('cell').first
    total_records_text = await total_records_cell.text_content()
    
    # Return the total records text as-is
    return total_records_text
